hero.purpose: Landing/campaign hero only — Cormorant Garamond Light, max 96px.

h1.purpose: Primary section titles — Cormorant Garamond Light.

h3.purpose: UI section headers and card titles — Montserrat SemiBold (the serif-to-sans switch).

body.purpose: Standard copy — Montserrat Regular, open 1.85 leading, 65–75ch measure.

label.purpose: Micro-labels and nav — Montserrat uppercase, ≥0.2em tracking.

accent.purpose: Pull-quotes and testimonials ONLY — EB Garamond Italic.

motion.name: transition-all
motion.purpose: Default state transition on buttons and interactive controls.

motion.name: press
motion.purpose: Active-press feedback on buttons — replaces shadow depth.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The main call to action — navy ground, uppercase, sharp corners.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; height: 40px; padding: 0 24px; background: #0f1b4c; color: #f8f7f4; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 0; font-family: Montserrat, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.2em; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.2s, transform 0.1s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: rgba(15,27,76,0.9); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: none; border-color: #1a2b6b; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px rgba(26,43,107,0.3); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px); }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Supporting action — cream ground, navy ink.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; height: 40px; padding: 0 24px; background: #ede9e0; color: #080e22; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 0; font-family: Montserrat, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.2em; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.2s, transform 0.1s; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: rgba(237,233,224,0.8); } .ds-btn-secondary:active { transform: translateY(1px); }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Lowest-emphasis action — no fill until hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; height: 40px; padding: 0 24px; background: transparent; color: #080e22; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 0; font-family: Montserrat, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.2em; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.2s; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: #ede9e0; }

components.name: Card
components.description: Flat cream surface, sharp corners, 32px padding, no shadow.
components.html:
Sliding Systems

Architectural partitions and sliding doors engineered for contemporary Indian homes.
components.css: .ds-card { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 12px; padding: 32px; background: #ede9e0; color: #080e22; border-radius: 0; overflow: hidden; } .ds-card-title { font-family: 'Cormorant Garamond', Georgia, serif; font-size: 24px; font-weight: 300; letter-spacing: -0.01em; } .ds-card-body { font-family: Montserrat, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.85; letter-spacing: 0.02em; color: rgba(8,14,34,0.7); margin: 0; }

components.name: Underline Input
components.description: Draughting-line field — transparent, 1px bottom border only, no box.
components.css: .ds-input { width: 100%; height: 48px; padding: 8px 0; background: transparent; color: #080e22; border: none; border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(8,14,34,0.14); border-radius: 0; font-family: Montserrat, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 15px; outline: none; transition: border-color 0.2s; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: rgba(8,14,34,0.45); } .ds-input:focus { border-bottom-color: #0f1b4c; }

components.name: Nav Link
components.description: Uppercase Montserrat Light, wide 0.3em tracking, gold underline on hover.
components.css: .ds-nav-link { position: relative; font-family: Montserrat, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 300; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.3em; color: #080e22; text-decoration: none; padding-bottom: 4px; } .ds-nav-link::after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 0; bottom: 0; width: 0; height: 1px; background: #c9a96e; transition: width 0.25s ease; } .ds-nav-link:hover::after { width: 100%; }

narrative.overview: Novesso reads like a printed design monograph rendered for the screen. Cormorant Garamond carries the display voice — light-weight, large, with a confident negative tracking — while Montserrat does the architectural work of labels, body, and navigation in disciplined uppercase. The page is a magazine spread: generous voids, a deep Midnight Navy ground, Antique Gold used the way a printer would spot-varnish a single mark. This system is confident, modern, and understated. Restraint is the flex: hierarchy and space, not ornament, signal luxury. Gold is punctuation — it marks the one thing that matters in a view and never washes a surface.
keyCharacteristics: Zero-radius everything; corners are sharp by doctrine.
Flat surfaces — depth comes from tonal navy/cream layering, never shadow.
Gold as a ≤10% accent; navy + cream do all the structural work.
Architectural spacing: generous, varied, never a uniform card grid.

rules.name: The Gold-as-Punctuation Rule
rules.body: Antique Gold appears on ≤10% of any view — one rule, one mark, one emphasized word. The moment gold fills a surface or repeats across a grid, it has failed.

rules.name: The Flat-Ground Rule
rules.body: Depth is built from navy/cream tonal layering and image overlays, never from drop shadows. If a surface needs to lift, darken or lighten the ground, don't float it.

rules.name: The Serif-Voice / Sans-Structure Rule
rules.body: Cormorant speaks (hero, H1, H2, large card titles); Montserrat structures (H3 down, all labels, nav, body). Never set body in Cormorant; never set a hero in Montserrat.

rules.name: The Caps-Tracking Rule
rules.body: Uppercase Montserrat always carries ≥0.2em tracking. Tight caps are forbidden.

rules.name: The No-Shadow Rule
rules.body: Drop shadows are forbidden as a depth device. Replace any card shadow with a tonal ground change or a 1px border.

dos: Do keep every corner sharp — rounded-none / 0px on buttons, cards, inputs, modals.
Do restrict Antique Gold to ≤10% of any view.
Do convey depth with tonal navy/cream layering and image overlays, never shadow.
Do set display type in Cormorant and all functional/UI type in Montserrat caps.
Do keep uppercase Montserrat at ≥0.2em tracking and body measure at 65–75ch.
Do verify navy/cream and muted-text pairings hit WCAG 2.1 AA (≥4.5:1 body).
Do give every GSAP/scroll interaction a prefers-reduced-motion fallback.
donts: Don't ship a generic SaaS landing: no gradient hero, no repeated feature-card grid, no eyebrow above every section, no 01/02/03 markers by reflex.
Don't do loud gold-everything luxury — gold is a mark, never a wash.
Don't add drop shadows for depth, use border-radius on any control, or nest cards.
Don't set body copy in Cormorant or a hero in Montserrat.
Don't use gradient text or decorative glassmorphism.
